entities.name: GatA amidase subunit
observations: 485 aa, approximately 51.5 kDa; exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Geobacter sulfurreducens Q746Y7.
Belongs to the amidase domain family PF01425, spanning residues 24–466.
Catalytic subunit A of the heterotrimeric GatCAB amidotransferase complex.

entities.name: Glutamine hydrolysis to glutamate
observations: L-glutamine + H2O → L-glutamate + NH4(+); EC 3.5.1.2; Rhea RHEA:15889.
In GatCAB, the released ammonia is transferred through the complex to the GatB subunit for tRNA amidation.

entities.name: GatCAB amidotransferase complex
observations: Heterotrimeric complex composed of GatA, GatB, and GatC; supports formation of correctly charged Asn-tRNA(Asn) or Gln-tRNA(Gln) from misacylated Asp/Glu-tRNAs.
The overall pathway uses glutamine and ATP and proceeds through activated phospho-Asp-tRNA(Asn) or phospho-Glu-tRNA(Gln).
